title: Heavenly Warning For Friends of Shaytan
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad yaa Sultan.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, SubhaanAllah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah
O our Lord, O our Creator! Yaa Rabbana! Yaa Rabbana! Yaa rabbighfir w 'arham wa anta khayru 'rraahimeen! All praising and all glory to the most honored one in the Divinely Presence, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s), to be on him from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. We are asking forgiveness and his intercession
for his weak ummah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee. Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad. Thumma 's-salaam, then we are giving our greetings to
our master, pole, qutb of this world, that the whole world is under his control. He is controlling, and we are
saying as-salaamu `alaykum to our listeners. Allah Almighty gives to you much more honor and much more
lights that you are trying to be present for this meeting every night or every day. Every day blessings are on
you also! Allah forgives you and forgives me.

We have been ordered to say as-salaamu `alaykum, because salaam is bringing peace on you, and on whom is
giving an answer on it, wa `alaykumu 's-salaam wa rahmatullah wa barakaatuh. Whoever is beginning first is
taking more blessings, honor, and lights. Therefore, the holy sunnah is to begin with as-salaamu `alaykum.
Allah is granting from His endless Mercy Oceans and His endless barakaat, blessings, it is not the same, but it
doesn't matter. Now we are saying a'oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, as the beginning. We are
taking our safety to be under divinely safety. We are in need to prevent the most terrible and dangerous
enemy, Shaytan. When we are saying a'oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, we are making ourselves
under heavenly protection, and Shaytan is running away. Therefore, we are always saying , a`oodhu billahi
min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, (meaning), "O our Lord! We are running to You from shaytanic tricks and
traps." Shaytan is running after Mankind to make them to fall into his trap, and when a person is going to be
through Shaytan's trap, it is difficult to be taken out. Therefore, beware of Shaytan's tricks and traps. If you
are getting a protection to be in safety from shaytanic tricks and traps, you can do what you have been
ordered through salaat, prayers.
First of all, when praying one must say a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem to make Shaytan run
away from him. It is enough for weak ones to say it once, but holy ones from awliya are saying that it is
sunnah and enough to say a'oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem at the beginning of the first raka`at.
But the ahlu 'l-azaaim, the high-level servants, are saying for them it is an order at the beginning of every
raka`at to say a'oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. First when you are saying a`oodhu billahi min
ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, Shaytan is running away, and looking if you are getting up for second raka`at, (and
he is) also approaching to throw in it something to make your prayers not 100-percent clean. Therefore, if for
every raka`at if you are saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, you are preventing Shaytan from
approaching, and so on.
And for every meeting or every association that we are in, we must use a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'rrajeem. It prevents Shaytan and he cannot come and write on you. If you are not saying this, Shaytan is
coming and riding on you and making you his donkey. Now you are seeing and you may say 100-percent, or if
you like to say 99-percent, doesn't matter, but now 100-percent of people are under shaytanic control. If you
are giving your control in the hands of your enemy, what do you think it shall finally be? Taking you to a safe

place? Can't be, but now, people are saying for Shaytan, "O my best friend, once again you are with me."
"Yes sir, I am with you always, but you are not putting your eyeglasses on to see me. How are you seeing me?"
"I am seeing such an ugly face, a dirty, dirty and dark, black face. "
"O really? I am following you, but I am sorry I am following you."
"Don't worry. Follow me because I am such a good leader for you, for your family, for your country, and for
the whole world. I am that one, you must believe in me, O my best friend."
"I am sorry to look to you in such a way, you are so ugly one."
"No, that ugliness, O my friend, it is because I am like a mirror and you are looking in the mirror and that
ugly face is your face!"
"Ptuu (spit) on that face!"
Now people are saying for Shaytan, "How are you cursing our best friend, from whom we learned everything
for modernized living or modernizing? We are learning from our best friend. When we are asking for his
name he is saying, 'Are you not recognizing me? I am Mr. Farkarolafi.'"
"I have never heard of such a name."
"Yes, if I am saying my name is James, or Popins or Shaytan ... or Gretatic or another one, then you are
taking and Egypt or from other countries, they shall be very angry. Therefore, I am using an unusual name
that you never heard of."
"What was that name, please my friend?"
"Mister Farkarolafi? Such a name you have never heard. Yes, I am keeping my friends to not make them
angry with me, but they are never getting angry with me because I am quickly making them get happy,
saying, 'O my good friend, please taste a couple whiskey, and your looking is going to change about my face.
Drink it and look to me, you shall find me the most handsome one among people.'"
"Who is that one?"
"O my darling, don't ask. You are sometimes sitting and sleeping; it is a dream."
"I don't think so, O my darling, it is not a dream, but it is a real vision for me."
Shaytan is using so many tricks to make people happy with him, saying, "I am your best friend. Please drink
this once again. You shall find me so beautiful; drink a third cup and you shall find me as the most handsome
person through this world, and fifth, sixth cup, you shall say, 'O my best one, who is bringing me in life.'"

A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, Allah protects us! Now Shaytan is the best friend for everyone,
men and women, male or female, making the female (to be) men, making male (to be) women. Making a
female, a man. Changing everything.
People are saying, "O we are living in the 21st century. O my friend, that is what is coming to my memory.
Sometimes I think someone is speaking to me in my ear and that is disappearing and I am coming to think on
it deeply. But when I am going to think on it deeply, another one on same type is coming and saying, 'O my
friend, what are you thinking? Your face looks like just before someone is coming to me, and I think that you
are his representative.'"
Yes sir, I am only his servant, but our leader is someone who is never ashamed from anyone, not even his
Creator! Such a foolish one, and ordering me to come to teach you, and if you are asking such an honor that
we have been granted from our master, if you would like to drink, have another."
He is saying, "O my darling, someone is speaking to me, but I am never finding that one."
"O my darling, you are sitting and dreaming; nothing is happening. Don't say once again such a thing. People
may say about you that you are becoming a mad one, losing your memory and speaking such strange words.
What are you drinking?"
"I am drinking whiskey." A`oodhu billah!
"No, you must drinking champagne, it is much more powerful in making your memory strong, and you can
speak like Hitler! In east or west there are so many friends of Shaytan. You are going to be like that one. Keep
yourself! Always continue drinking champagne if you are asking to have a good memory and be a respected
one; at least daily you must drink one bottle of champagne, daily one bottle."
"O my darling, I tried it but when I am drinking one bottle, I can't walk."
"It doesn't matter, there is a big basket that owner just prepared. When you are entering you are looking that
there are ten or more baskets. If you are drinking, and your mind changing, your view changing, and you are
imagining working much more, then you can't be able to walk, taking you, putting you in a basket, and
carrying you. Don't worry!"
I am making a theater for modernized people; they should be happy with my speech! (laughter) That is a
dirty life that only Shaytan is happy with such dirty people. Sadanas' importance is to make people in such a
way, to be put in a basket and to be carried behind a car, because they can't put through cars, everywhere it is

full with dirtiness, from their mouth and under, they are such dirty ones, that the owner of cars saying, "We
can't carry this person inside."
Therefore, open the trunk and put him there and close it firmly, because may find a way to open it and then
falling down, then government who is also like him coming to ask a punishment. Therefore, they put him in a
basket and put the cover on it with ropes tied, that people may look and say, "Those people are westernized
and they are the most modernized people that ever happened, ever found."
People are coming around, and when they are coming to his place, people are running around, coming to take
the basket from the trunk, and people are making, (claps and makes sounds of cheering). "O our first-class
man! Monsieur, monsieur, trunk just arrived and they are making for you (claps and cheers)!"
"O my darling, what is happening?
And his darling saying, "O my darling, we just reached home."
"Am I sleeping in my bed? Where am I?"
That is the 21st century civilization! You may be honored, O European people, and O western people, and you
are followers! You may be proud to be people in such a way, but your Lord's hammer is ready to come on you!
Now there is a little bit of silence from western people, all the troubles are throughout the Middle East or Far
East, but your turn will now come, coming to you also. Sometimes they are showing the BBC Weather News,
that it is coming close like this, like this, like this on them. Now it is coming, a cursing going around this
world, and coming suddenly on people and taking away the majority of people from this dirty life!
O People! Come to Islam! O Salafi `ulamas! Why are you not standing up and saying to people, "O people,
come into Islam?" Yet you are running after us if we are making salaat was-salaam or we are asking for
intercession, you are attacking us! Why are you not standing up to attack modernized western people to save
them from their dirty life? Why are you not standing up and crying, "O Europeans! Come to Islam, come to a
clean life and merciful life, come make your Creator happy with you!" That is the majesty of Islam, but you
are not taking care. You are only a handful of people running from one mosque to another mosque, saying
not to say, As-salaatu was-salaam `alayka yaa Sayyidee, yaa Rasulullah! May Allah forgives us!
O People! Islam is only cleaning dirty life from Earth, nothing else. innama 'l-mushriqoona najasun, Those
people (mushriq, polytheist) from the dirty life can't be clean, even you may put on them oceans. Salafi

`ulamas, why are you not saying that the Lord of Heavens is saying, innama 'l-mushriqoona najasun, and
tanween, ta`zheem wa takbeer, that you can't find any word to make it so clear! Allah Almighty's show to the
whole nation that whom they are not following the Last Message of the Holy Qur'an, and the Last Messenger,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s), they should be in dirtiness! Yaa Sayyidee, yaa Rasoolullah! (Mawlana Shaykh
stands, sits.)
If you are trying to use whole detergents, or other cleaners, or if using ocean's waters, they can't be cleaned,
najasun (filthy ones that cannot be purified).Why are you not saying, Salafi `ulamas? This is another point
that they are making me to speak and to address to you particularly. You are in holy lands and you are
claiming that, "We are the best `ulamas." What are you doing? Allah Almighty is ordering `ulamas to be
speakers, to make the realities from the Holy Qur'an to people. Why are you not doing what is waajib,
obligatory for you? Don't attack weak people, asking, "Why are you saying as-salaatu wa 's-salaamu `alayk?"
Leave that, it is not the way of real `ulamas. Leave Muslims and attack on modernized shaytanic territories!
You must do that, if not Allah Almighty sawfa yantaqim min kum, taking His revenge from you, making you
forget everything and you should be empty-headed people!
That is another heavenly warning. If anyone through the Islamic world or through the whole world can say,
"You are a wrong one," you may come and speak. I am only a warner, nazeer.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah. May Allah forgive us. As-salaamu `alaykum.
Fatihah.
Dome Dome, Dome Dome, Dome Dome, Dome Dome 6x
O our Lord, O our Lord forgives us! We are all sinners and we are in need, really in need for Your most
beloved and honored servant's (s) intercession. Grant us, O our Lord, for the honor of your best and most
honored servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh satnds, sits.) Zidhu yaa Rabbee, sharafan wa
karaman.
Fatihah.

Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah. (du`a)
(45 minutes)
(Mawlana Shaykh happily speaks on the phone with Mawlana Shaykh Hisham and Hajjah Naziha.)
